provenance_policy: OEM Xiaomi MiCode sources and verified manufacturer stock firmware only
notes: The public M11A initialization table still differs from MIUI and HyperOS. The corrected 90 Hz source sequence and the 60/120 Hz sequences decode to 57 DSI packets each. Normal white 1000/110 nit, green 500 nit, off-to-normal and off-to-HBM payloads match both reviewed global firmware entries at all three rates. The 110 nit alpha update length is limited to the two data bytes in the actual 0x87 packet. White 1000/110 nit from doze, return to high/low doze, both doze brightness levels and exit from doze match both firmware entries at all three refresh rates. The physical panel revision and fingerprint operation require verification.

stock_os3_panel_commands.reason: Xiaomi's public M11A table has a 57-packet initialization and 11-packet switch; stock OS3 initializes every mode with its own 135-packet sequence (calibration, gamma/demura, post display-on settings) and switches with 10 packets. These are panel-controller commands sent unchanged by our Qualcomm DSI driver, so the stock sequences are used for all three modes (60/90/120 Hz).
